segments.en: I work in a bank, you?
Oh my god, I work in Jana Small Finance Bank.
Work is not done yet, it's done for me, yours?
I am on leave today, you?
What to tell, how is work going, life, everything?
Okay, is your family married or you?
I am married, that's why I asked.
Why did you ask, you look like you are of marriageable age.
My native place is in Andhra side, I am an area manager here.
Are you staying in a PG?
No, I have rented a room. I used to work there from my hometown, from there I got transferred here with a promotion.
What else is good for bankers?
Yes, this Saturday, Sunday, Monday, three days leave.
Same for me, I am going to my hometown tomorrow.
How many days has it been since you started using this?
I came yesterday, I was alone in Bangalore, someone suggested this, so I came.
I have been in Bangalore for a month now.
Actually, it's a new place, right?
Need to adjust, right, for us too.
It will be fine, don't worry. Bangalore is very good, everyone adjusts here.
How long has it been since you came?
I came to Bangalore three years ago.
What did you do for Dussehra?
It should be, we have to adjust ourselves.
No, you know, in Bangalore PGs, there are more Andhra PGs, so the food will be adjusted to that.
Andhra means, it's not Andhra, it's on the Karnataka border.
It's near Kolar, near Kolar side.
I, when I first came to Bangalore, it was near Kolar, there was an iPhone manufacturing company in Narasapura, you know?
At that time it was Wistron, now it is Tata.
Okay, how many days did you work there?
No, I worked there for 10 months, it was very difficult, there were no leaves, I couldn't even go to other places.
I was stuck there, then I left and came to Bangalore, and in one week I settled in another place.
Oh, gold loan, okay, is it cash or business or sales?
Sales, sales, earlier I was doing operations, they put a lot of pressure, so I have to do sales and look after operations.
That's why I jumped to sales, here it has been six months since I joined.
Incentives come, but it's difficult, I work in gold loan.
Gold loan, it depends on the location, Koramangala is a rich area, right?
Family misses, what to do, have to do it for work.
Have you gone to your hometown since you came?
Have you gone to your hometown since you came to Bangalore?
No, I will go, I have a car, whenever I get time I will go, I don't go by train, it gets too late, so I go by car.
It's nearby, you can go and come, KR Puram, right? If it was on this side, it would be a bit difficult.
You can go from there, no problem.
You tell me, I am listening.
When are you going to your hometown, tomorrow?
Yes, tomorrow, tomorrow there is no leave, tomorrow I will take permission and go.
Go, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, you will come on Monday?
Monday is a festival in our town, Panchami is also on that day, so Monday I won't come.
Tuesday or Wednesday I should come, I have thought, I need leave, it's been a month since I went to my hometown.
So I am missing it, I need leave, let's see.
Here, on weekends, where do you go, what do you do, do you have friends?
There is no one like that, I used to go every 15 days, but this last month, activities, this and that, I couldn't go during leave time.
I wasn't well either, so I didn't go, second Saturday, fourth Saturday I normally go to my hometown.
Here, this time I didn't go anywhere, just stayed in PG, if I go, it's office or this content, that's it.
Same here, the problem is here.
It's like, if you go to the office, you have to go somewhere, it feels like, early morning they take an hour to get ready.
I asked who takes the gold loan.
Gold loan, our team takes it, the branch manager takes it, our branch banking is done.
On this side, they also take it, our gold team also takes it, target is not there, but complete target is not asked, poor people, they are good people.
They don't just bring and keep it, they have to trust us, in our branch, they don't understand how they play, you know?
Today is a holiday, I don't know anything, today is a holiday, they say, when I say that, I just get up and come.
Where can I bring it from, you tell me.
For that, they say, okay, I will do it, I will say, follow-ups are there, you know, mine is the worst, the worst.
Now I will come here, they say, one hour is enough, right, if you go to any bank, any industry, they will finish it in 20 to 30 minutes, maximum one hour, think so.

Here they say, I will come, okay, like this, like that, they say, one week, one month, I have been following up, madam, I will come today, or tomorrow morning, madam, I have an emergency, like this, like that, they say, if I call, they don't respond, after a few days, I will know, no madam, there interest is low, and they know others, we haven't paid interest, even then, gold won't be auctioned, yours, I don't trust madam, like this, like that, they say.
What to say, they don't listen, they don't ask, I will come, I will come, they say, and at the last minute, they raise their hands.

It's difficult, gold loan, it's not that good, but what to do, activation is done, then no one listens, they give a gap to breathe, if it's something else, if we go to clarity, we have to do all products.
Which one, which one is yours?
You, I mean, in which one do you do, which department?
For that customer, I have to follow up.
That is a bit irritating, right?

Oh, here our server is there, they do it like this, you know, I mean, other branch managers, they are in collection, the branch head, they are, sometimes, I mean, starting, their branch training, they were freshers, right?
I am a little bit of a small girl, so they talk nicely, they call and say, I will give you a number, give it.
